items.title: Utkarsh Small Finance Bank posts Rs 34 crore Q1 loss; asset quality stress persists
items.description: Utkarsh Small Finance Bank reported a net loss of Rs 34 crore for the June quarter, marking its fifth consecutive quarterly loss, as elevated asset quality stress continued to weigh on its performance. While the loss narrowed significantly on lower provisions, the lender's gross non-performing assets remained high at 6.1%.

items.title: Muthoot Finance reports 25% rise in Q1 profit, announces leadership transition
items.description: Muthoot Finance reported a 25% year-on-year rise in standalone net profit to Rs 2,550 crore for the June quarter, driven by robust growth in its gold loan business. The company also announced a leadership transition, with Alexander George Muthoot set to take over as managing director from October 1, subject to shareholder approval.
